title: Security of Tweakable Even–Mansour Variants
summary: Traditional two-round variants have been studied; determine the security of tweakable Even–Mansour constructions with permutation reuse, non-independent round keys, or both.

formal_statement.body: Variants with permutation reuse or non-independent round keys have been studied for the traditional two-round iterated Even--Mansour cipher, but their security remains to be determined for tweakable Even--Mansour constructions. Determine the security of tweakable variants that reuse the same permutation across rounds, use non-independent round keys, or impose both conditions.

scope.domain: Security analysis of tweakable Even–Mansour block-cipher constructions with permutation reuse and non-independent round keys.
parameters: Permutation usage across rounds: whether the same permutation is reused
Round-key dependence: whether round keys are non-independent
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the security of tweakable variants with permutation reuse, non-independent round keys, or both conditions.

progress.summary: The paper lists these variants among its open problems and points to their prior study for the traditional two-round iterated Even–Mansour cipher, leaving their security in the tweakable setting unresolved.
citation_labels: Benoît Cogliati et al., Tweaking Even-Mansour Ciphers
